storeInfo.name: Nick's Diner
storeInfo.tagline: Classic American Comfort Food & Classic Diner Favorites | Comida clásica americana y favoritos de siempre

policies.restroomLocationEs: Ubicado hacia la parte trasera del salón principal, pasando la caja.
policies.restroomLocationEn: Located towards the back of the main dining room past the register.
policies.restroomCodeEn: Open for dining guests (no code required).
policies.parkingPolicyEs: Estacionamiento disponible en la calle y en el lote público cercano.
policies.parkingPolicyEn: Street parking and nearby municipal lot parking available.
policies.returnPolicyEs: Nos esforzamos por su completa satisfacción; por favor informe a su mesero de cualquier inconveniente de inmediato.
policies.returnPolicyEn: We strive for complete guest satisfaction; please notify your server of any issues immediately.
policies.deliveryPolicyEs: Servicio para llevar disponible por teléfono y plataformas de entrega locales.
policies.deliveryPolicyEn: Takeout service available by phone and local delivery platforms.

products.nameEs: Aros de cebolla gruesos empanizados y fritos hasta dorar, servidos con salsa especial de la casa.
products.descriptionEn: Thick-cut sweet onions, battered and golden fried, served with house special dipping sauce.

products.nameEs: Papas Fritas Cargadas con Queso y Tocino
products.descriptionEs: Papas fritas crujientes cubiertas con mezcla de quesos derretidos, tocino crujiente y crema agria.
products.descriptionEn: Golden crispy french fries piled high with melted cheddar, crispy bacon bits, and cool sour cream.
Tender chicken wings tossed in tangy signature buffalo sauce, served with crisp celery and chunky bleu cheese.

products.nameEs: Hamburguesa Clásica con Queso de Nick
products.descriptionEn: Juicy grilled beef patty with American cheese, crisp lettuce, tomato, red onion, and mayo on a toasted brioche bun.
Sliced roast turkey, crisp bacon, fresh lettuce, tomato, and mayo stacked high on three slices of toasted bread.
Hand-mixed flaky tuna salad on grilled rye bread topped with melted Swiss cheese.
Sizzling center-cut NY strip steak served with two farm-fresh eggs, golden hash browns, and toasted bread.
A stack of three thick, golden buttermilk pancakes served with whipped butter and pure maple syrup.
Crispy golden chicken tenderloins served with french fries and your choice of honey mustard or BBQ sauce.
Tender corned beef brisket, tangy sauerkraut, melted Swiss, and Russian dressing on grilled rye bread.

products.nameEs: Batido Cremoso de Vainilla o Chocolate
products.descriptionEn: Rich hand-spun milkshake made with real ice cream, whole milk, whipped cream, and a cherry on top.
Freshly ground medium-roast diner coffee with unlimited refills for dine-in guests.

faqs.qEn: Do you offer vegetarian or gluten-free options?
faqs.aEs: Sí, contamos con opciones vegetarianas y podemos adaptar ciertos platillos. Pregunte a su mesero.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer vegetarian items and can modify certain dishes upon request. Please ask your server.

faqs.qEs: ¿Aceptan reservaciones o es por orden de llegada?
faqs.qEn: Do you accept reservations or is it walk-in only?
faqs.aEs: Operamos principalmente por orden de llegada, pero aceptamos llamadas para grupos grandes.
faqs.aEn: We operate primarily on a walk-in basis, but gladly accept phone inquiries for larger parties.

faqs.aEs: Sí, ofrecemos servicio para llevar directo en el local y trabajamos con plataformas de entrega locales.
faqs.aEn: Yes, we offer direct takeout service and partner with local delivery apps.
